items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A text or icon-supported action control with HaloUI material, semantic variants, accessible interaction states, and consistent keyboard behavior.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A compact icon-only control for common actions, with mandatory accessible naming, HaloUI material states, and consistent keyboard and touch behavior.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Visually connects related independent actions while preserving the semantics, focus behavior, and activation model of each control.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Combines a primary immediate action with a secondary menu of closely related alternative actions.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state action control that communicates and changes a persistent pressed or unpressed state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Single- or multi-selection set of toggles.

items.name: floating-action-button
items.title: Floating Action Button
items.description: A prominent floating control for exposing a high-priority contextual action above the surrounding interface.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard and provides short-lived accessible feedback when the operation succeeds or fails.

items.name: favorite-button
items.title: Favorite Button
items.description: A specialized persistent toggle action for saving, bookmarking, or favoriting items across sessions.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A compact control for switching between a small set of mutually exclusive modes or values.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: A contextual container for organizing actions related to the user's current selection or task.

items.name: halo-surface
items.title: Halo Surface
items.description: The base material container used to construct HaloUI surfaces with 10-layer physical liquid optical physics.

items.name: surface
items.title: Halo Surface (Alias)
items.description: The base material container used to construct HaloUI surfaces with 10-layer physical liquid optical physics.

items.name: halo-edge
items.title: Halo Edge
items.description: Layered outer and inset optical boundary treatment for translucent HaloUI materials.

items.name: edge
items.title: Halo Edge (Alias)
items.description: Layered outer and inset optical boundary treatment for translucent HaloUI materials.

items.name: halo-highlight
items.title: Halo Highlight
items.description: Directional reflected-light and restrained specular treatment communicating surface orientation and physical material response against HaloUI's 135° virtual light vector.

items.name: highlight
items.title: Halo Highlight (Alias)
items.description: Directional reflected-light and restrained specular treatment communicating surface orientation and physical material response against HaloUI's 135° virtual light vector.

items.name: halo-noise
items.title: Halo Noise
items.description: Subtle material grain and high-frequency procedural texture used to reduce sterile gradient banding and impart physical tooth to HaloUI liquid glass surfaces.

items.name: noise
items.title: Halo Noise (Alias)
items.description: Subtle material grain and high-frequency procedural texture used to reduce sterile gradient banding and impart physical tooth to HaloUI liquid glass surfaces.

items.name: halo-glow
items.title: Halo Glow
items.description: Ambient luminous layer used selectively for active state, emphasis, or focus-adjacent depth.

items.name: glow
items.title: Halo Glow (Alias)
items.description: Ambient luminous layer used selectively for active state, emphasis, or focus-adjacent depth.

items.name: halo-refraction-layer
items.title: Halo Refraction Layer
items.description: Optional progressive-enhancement optical layer that introduces restrained environmental distortion to selected HaloUI materials with a guaranteed non-refraction fallback.

items.name: refraction
items.title: Halo Refraction Layer (Alias)
items.description: Optional progressive-enhancement optical layer that introduces restrained environmental distortion to selected HaloUI materials with a guaranteed non-refraction fallback.

items.name: halo-focus-ring
items.title: Halo Focus Ring
items.description: Shared high-contrast focus-visible treatment for HaloUI interactive components. Operates independently outside the optical material boundary to guarantee unambiguous keyboard accessibility.

items.name: focus-ring
items.title: Halo Focus Ring (Alias)
items.description: Shared high-contrast focus-visible treatment for HaloUI interactive components. Operates independently outside the optical material boundary to guarantee unambiguous keyboard accessibility.

items.name: halo-motion-presets
items.title: Halo Motion Presets
items.description: Central motion vocabulary standardizing press compression, elevation lift, spring-settle entrance, and graceful reduced-motion fallbacks across HaloUI.

items.name: motion-presets
items.title: Halo Motion Presets (Alias)
items.description: Central motion vocabulary standardizing press compression, elevation lift, spring-settle entrance, and graceful reduced-motion fallbacks across HaloUI.

items.name: halo-theme-provider
items.title: Halo Theme Provider
items.description: Orchestrates HaloUI light, dark and system visual themes together with shared optical material intensity defaults.

items.name: halo-background
items.title: Halo Background
items.description: Reference background environments for testing and evaluating translucent liquid materials against diverse optical substrates.

items.name: halo-portal-surface
items.title: Halo Portal Surface
items.description: Consistent liquid-glass material wrapper for portalled floating overlays, modal dialogs, popovers, and menus.

items.name: halo-scrim
items.title: Halo Scrim
items.description: Backdrop and scrim treatment positioned behind modal dialogs and overlays with calibrated optical diffusion blur and ambient darkness.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A semantic composition primitive that connects a form control with its label, description, validation message, and related field context.

items.name: field-group
items.title: Field Group
items.description: Organizes multiple related fields into a consistent structural group while preserving each field's individual semantics.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible text label for associating a visible name with a form control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line native text-entry control with HaloUI material states, accessible focus treatment, validation support, and consistent form behavior.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Composes an Input with contextual prefixes, suffixes, icons, text, or actions inside a shared control boundary.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A native multiline text-entry control with HaloUI form states, accessible focus treatment, and configurable resizing.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled native select for simple, reliable single-value choices using the browser and operating system's built-in selection behavior.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: An accessible custom option picker for selecting one value from a structured list of choices.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An accessible searchable option picker for selecting one value from a filterable collection.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A searchable multi-value picker for selecting and managing multiple options as removable tokens.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: An accessible boolean selection control supporting unchecked, checked, and indeterminate states.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: A related set of independent checkbox options for selecting zero, one, or multiple values.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: An accessible mutually exclusive option set for selecting one value from a related group.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible binary control for immediately turning a setting on or off.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An accessible single-value range control for choosing a numeric value within defined minimum and maximum bounds.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: An accessible two-thumb range control for selecting a bounded numeric interval.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A segmented one-time-code input optimized for short verification codes, paste, mobile keyboards, and platform OTP autofill.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: An accessible numeric-entry control with keyboard editing, decimal precision, range boundaries, and optional increment/decrement actions.

items.name: currency-field
items.title: Currency Field
items.description: A locale-aware monetary entry control that separates numeric value from currency presentation.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: Phone Field
items.description: A structured phone-number input for entering international telephone numbers with country context, formatting, and accessible validation support.

items.name: url-field
items.title: URL Field
items.description: A URL-oriented text-entry control with browser-friendly input semantics, optional normalization, and clear validation affordances.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: An accessible multi-token tag editor with two-stage deletion, delimiter and paste tokenization, duplicate prevention, and keyboard navigation.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File Input
items.description: An accessible native file-selection control with HaloUI form styling and clear selected-file feedback.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: An accessible client-side file-upload workflow with native file selection, drag-and-drop, validation, queue state management, progress tracking, cancellation, retry, and transport-agnostic application integration.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: An accessible color-selection control combining visual color adjustment (2D Saturation/Brightness canvas and 1D Hue spectrum) with precise textual hexadecimal entry and zero optical material contamination.

items.name: rating-input
items.title: Rating Input
items.description: An accessible single-value rating control for choosing a score from an ordered icon-based scale.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: An accessible calendar-backed control for selecting a single calendar date.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: An accessible calendar-backed control for selecting a start and end date as one ordered date interval.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: An accessible time-only control for selecting a local clock time without introducing a calendar date or timezone.

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: Date Time Picker
items.description: An accessible control for selecting one calendar date and one local clock time as a combined date-time value.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: An accessible standalone calendar surface for navigating and selecting calendar dates.

items.name: form-message
items.title: Form Message
items.description: A semantic field-level message for communicating validation errors, success, warnings, or concise supporting feedback.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: An accessible tabbed interface for switching between peer content views within the same context.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A semantic navigation trail that communicates the current page's position within a hierarchical structure.
